summary: All three round-1 confirmed_blocking findings are fixed with accepted-form red proofs and five-way dist parity, but the fix diff accidentally deleted the LockCliTests class header, silently dropping two FR-005 CLI-level tests.

findings.summary: The fix commit deleted the `class LockCliTests(unittest.TestCase):` header, orphaning its setUp and two test methods after unittest.main(), so the suite lost both FR-005 CLI-level lock tests.
findings.evidence: fb6f95f defines the class at line 158; HEAD has none; discovery runs 125 tests without them. No plan exemption. ENG-1, ENG-5.
findings.fix: Restore the class above the main guard with setUp and both tests intact.
